svg.title: Separate research, review and client care
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-small-team-org; chart type: org_architecture; title: Separate research, review and client care; subtitle: Roles may be fractional; authority must remain distinct; chapter number: 9; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are role identifiers, not headcounts, hierarchy ranks or compensation.; caption: The owner coordinates researchers and client care; independent licensed advisers retain professional judgment.; stages: label: Owner / case lead; value: Role 1; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Accountable for intake gates, budgets and secure case access.; label: Research specialist; value: Role 2; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Reports case evidence to the lead; does not decide legal entitlement.; label: Client coordinator; value: Role 3; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Reports to the lead; tracks consent, requests and plain-language updates.; label: Independent counsel; value: Role 4; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Advises within a separate engagement; not controlled by a research sales target.
